observations: Blue mountain bicycle with a rigid front fork.
Equipped with a rear plastic mudguard.
Multi-speed drivetrain with a rear derailleur and triple crankset.
Rim brakes (V-brakes) installed on front and rear.
Knobby tires with visible tread depth.
Black saddle and flat handlebars with grip shifters.
Kickstand is attached to the rear chainstay.
No brand name, decals, or model identifiers are visible on the frame in either photo.

claims.evidence: The wheel size cannot be confirmed without a clear shot of the tire sidewall markings, and 'quality' is subjective without a visible brand.

risks.risk: The drivetrain (gears, chain, and shifters) may be seized, worn, or poorly indexed.
risks.proof: A video of the bicycle being pedaled while shifting through all gear combinations.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a full drivetrain service or replacement parts

risks.risk: The braking system may be ineffective due to worn pads or stretched cables.
risks.proof: A video showing the brakes successfully stopping the wheels from a high spin.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring new brake pads and cable adjustment

risks.risk: The wheels may be buckled or out of true.
risks.proof: A video of both wheels spinning freely to check for lateral wobble.

risks.risk: Tires may have hidden dry rot or the inner tubes may not hold air.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the tire sidewalls and a shot of the valves showing they are inflated.
risks.if_unproven: as needing immediate tire and tube replacement

proof_requests: Video of the bicycle being ridden and shifting through all gears.
Close-up photo of the tire sidewall to confirm the 26-inch size and check for dry rot.
Video of the wheels spinning to check for wobbles.
Close-up photo of the rear derailleur and brake pads.
response.reason: The item is a generic mountain bicycle of unknown brand. It can be priced as a basic used model in its worst-case mechanical condition based on the visible components.
